provenance_note:
Phase B canonical evidence records for the 10-MFB ingestion pilot (mfi-030, mfi-049, mfi-031, mfi-051, mfi-043 added in the 5→10 expansion; baseline 5: mfi-001, mfi-003, mfi-020, mfi-034, mfi-047). Only URLs with a real backing source are recorded. The sole proven URL per institution is the official website as published in the NRB BFI list (source nrb-bfi-mid-may-2026). All secondary capabilities (reports, notices, branches, career, news) are DISCOVERY INTENTS: known_url=null until Phase F discovery locates and snapshots a real page under the site domain. Nothing here is marked VERIFIED; every record starts CANDIDATE. No URL in this file was invented: every non-null url traces to nrb-bfi-mid-may-2026 (official_links entries, status=CANDIDATE, verified=0).
Phase R expansion: extended deterministically from 10 to 20 sources (next 10 ACTIVE master institutions with an NRB-proven official_website, by id ascending). Only WEBSITE has a real URL; all other capabilities remain discovery intents.
Phase R expansion: extended deterministically from 20 to 30 sources (next 10 ACTIVE master institutions with an NRB-proven official_website, by id ascending). Only WEBSITE has a real URL; all other capabilities remain discovery intents.
Phase R expansion: extended deterministically from 30 to 40 sources (next 10 ACTIVE master institutions with an NRB-proven official_website, by id ascending). Only WEBSITE has a real URL; all other capabilities remain discovery intents.
Phase R expansion: extended deterministically from 40 to 51 sources (next 11 ACTIVE master institutions with an NRB-proven official_website, by id ascending). Only WEBSITE has a real URL; all other capabilities remain discovery intents.
Phase F backfill: Discovery results from the pilot evidence DB persisted back into each capability's known_url where a real same-domain page was located & snapshotted (deterministic classification via the shared hint matcher, evidence-anchored: prefers the page that produced the capability's field assertions over a bare hint match; regenerated 2026-09-26). All statuses stay CANDIDATE; nothing is VERIFIED.
